final_hardening_findings: Home health could previously derive Good from an unvalidated latest summary.

Recovery could previously overstate scheduler cleanup success after a safe policy reset.
Dashboard mutations required cross-process serialization across multiple Control Center windows.
A second Control Center could previously disturb shared manual-scan status before the canonical scan lock rejected overlap.
Primary Dashboard copy still exposed unnecessary engineering jargon in default Overview paths.
Capability documentation contained two stale planned endpoint names.
Non-Git projects previously lacked an enforced final project snapshot contract for release freshness.
The first schema-v4 fingerprint instruction captured the snapshot too early; it now represents the final verified project state after authorized remediation and revalidation.
